components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action on a screen. Springs on press. Loses its colour when disabled.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--rms-action, #12804A); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--rms-action, #12804A); color: #fff; font: 800 16px/1.25 'Nunito Sans Variable', 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms, transform 420ms linear(0, 0.36 9%, 0.8 19%, 1.05 31%, 1.08 39%, 1.04 51%, 0.996 66%, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--rms-action-pressed, #006D3C); border-color: var(--rms-action-pressed, #006D3C); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.965); transition: transform 90ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1E2420; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #CAD6E2; border-color: #CAD6E2; color: #4C5661; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A white pill with coloured words, for everything that is not the main action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 20px; border: 1px solid #CAD6E2; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; color: var(--rms-action-ink, #007742); font: 700 16px/1.25 'Nunito Sans Variable', 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms, transform 420ms linear(0, 0.36 9%, 0.8 19%, 1.05 31%, 1.08 39%, 1.04 51%, 0.996 66%, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--rms-action-wash, #ECF5F1); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.965); transition: transform 90ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1E2420; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above, 48px box, 12px corners because you type in it rather than press it.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Nunito Sans Variable', 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1E2420; } .ds-field-label { font-weight: 700; line-height: 22px; } .ds-input { min-height: 48px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #76828E; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #1E2420; font: 400 16px/1.5 inherit; font-family: inherit; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #616C77; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #1E2420; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1E2420; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tags
components.description: Three weights of ink, no colour: a soft label, a note worth reading, something waiting on a person.
components.html: Sample numbers 1.3 points over Needs approval
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: #CAD6E2; color: #1E2420; font: 700 15px/16px 'Nunito Sans Variable', 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tag-outline { padding-block: 6.5px; border: 1.5px solid #1E2420; background: none; font-weight: 800; } .ds-tag-solid { background: #1E2420; color: #fff; font-weight: 800; }

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 20px 24px; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; color: #1E2420; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(30 36 32 / 0.06); font-family: 'Nunito Sans Variable', 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; } .ds-stat-label { color: #616C77; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 20px; } .ds-stat-value { font-size: 44px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 48px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-stat-aside { display: grid; justify-items: end; gap: 6px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-note { padding: 6.5px 12px; border: 1.5px solid #1E2420; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 16px; }

components.name: Rail Item
components.description: One line in the side rail. The current place is a white pill with coloured, heavier words.
components.html: HomeMini-appsSettings
components.css: .ds-rail { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 208px; padding: 8px; background: #DEE7F2; font-family: 'Nunito Sans Variable', 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; color: #1E2420; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms; } .ds-nav:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.6); } .ds-nav[aria-current="page"] { background: #fff; color: var(--rms-action-ink, #007742); font-weight: 800; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(30 36 32 / 0.06); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1E2420; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A restaurant owner looks at a calm screen and knows at a glance what is safe to touch. Colour is not decoration here. It is the one signal the whole system teaches: if it has colour, you can press it. Everything you only read is the slate ground, a white card, ink, or a hairline.
keyCharacteristics: One action colour. It is the restaurant's own brand colour, made safe by code.
Shape carries meaning: fully rounded is a button, 8 to 16px corners are something you read.
States are words plus ink shapes (outline, solid, tick, ring). Never colour.
One family, Nunito Sans, heavy for figures and headings, tabular figures everywhere.
Two densities: comfortable for talking and deciding, compact for report rows, charts and feeds.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: If it has colour, you can press it. Nothing coloured that cannot be pressed. A disabled action loses its colour entirely.

rules.name: The Brand Safety Rule
rules.body: A restaurant's colour never reaches the page directly. themeFromBrand(hex) keeps the hue and darkens only as far as it must so that white words on the fill and coloured words on card, ground and wash all pass WCAG AA. Black, white and greys are replaced by basil.

rules.name: The Ink State Rule
rules.body: Over target, slow week, done, in progress, needs approval: each is a word plus an ink shape.

rules.name: The Lined-up Figures Rule
rules.body: Tabular numerals on body. Money and counts are right-aligned in tables.

rules.name: The Shape Rule
rules.body: Fully rounded means you can press it. 8 to 16px corners mean you read it.

dos: Do give colour only to things that can be pressed.
Do say every state in words, with an ink shape beside it.
Do pass the restaurant's colour through themeFromBrand or <Theme brand>. Never paint it directly.
Do put anything you read on a white card, and use --rms-muted for secondary words.
Do use compact density for report rows, charts and feeds, and comfortable for everything else.
Do write in everyday words. No code, table names, tier codes or raw error text on owner screens.
donts: Don't colour a status, a tag, a chart series, a heading or an icon that cannot be pressed.
Don't use red, amber or green to mean bad, warning or good.
Don't round a label fully, or square off a button.
Don't nest cards, add a second accent colour, or add entry animations.
Don't write CSS, class names or inline styles in an app or a mini-app.
Don't show a second way in to "Ask" on a screen that already has one.
